name: kill-lokier-early
description: G7: cart runs ahead of his recording (from 6 s) through the Apartments to the window and fights Lokier there about 4 s before the recorded duel: Lokier, scoped on the corridor from Truck, sees him in it first, goes LIVE and shoots (a real hit); cart's real headshot kills him (X1d: he fires from (-1700, 740), at the window's east edge, as soon as he is there: on the 2020 mesh Lokier sees him only near the window, at 12.66 s, and eradicate, LIVE from 12.77 s, would take Lokier's head at 14.67 s before cart reached the CS2-tuned (-1712, 700)). Lokier's recorded kill of eradicate (12.75 s) is dropped. Then cart plays his recording again: the survivors rejoin their tape where it still makes sense, the Ts' push and plant go on, donk and barely carry on.
